signin.headline:
Every tool.
One login.
signin.lead: Orbit puts your tools in one place. Sign in once with Microsoft – your role decides what you see.
signin.hint: External partners sign in with the account the invitation was sent to.

errors.AccessDenied: Orbit isn't enabled for this account. Ask your administrator for access.
errors.Configuration: Sign-in isn't set up correctly. Check the Entra app registration and environment variables.

dashboard.dragHint: Move tiles by their handle to arrange them.
dashboard.dragPaused: Sorting is paused while searching or filtering.
dashboard.saveError: Layout not saved. Check your connection and move the tile again.
dashboard.noResultsCategory: There's no app for you in this category.
dashboard.emptyBody: Your account doesn't have any apps assigned yet. Ask your administrator to give you the right roles.

dnd.instructions: Press space or enter to pick up a tile. Use the arrow keys to move it, space or enter to drop it, and escape to cancel.

request.title: Request access
request.intro: Pick an app. Your administrator gets your request by email and enables your access.
request.messagePlaceholder: What do you need the app for?
request.successBody: You'll get a confirmation by email. Once approved, the app appears the next time you sign in.

errors.rate_limited: You've sent several requests in the last hour. Try again later.
errors.already_requested: You already have an open request for this app.
errors.mail_not_configured: Requests aren't set up yet. Contact your administrator directly.
errors.default: The request wasn't sent. Try again.
